name: Cross-Body Crunch
instructions: Lie flat on your back and bend your knees about 60 degrees, feet flat on the floor, hands loosely behind your head.
Curl up and bring your right elbow and shoulder across your body while bringing your left knee in toward your left shoulder at the same time.
Return to the starting position and repeat with the left elbow and right knee.
Continue alternating sides for the recommended amount of repetitions.
